description: District Secretariat of Rathnapura  - Pilgrimage Season of Sri Pada will commence on 10.12.2019 and terminate on 08.05.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification announces regulations and operational details for the Sri Pada pilgrimage season, referencing the Pilgrimages Ordinance (Chapter 175) and citing previous gazette notifications. It establishes legal/regulatory requirements for construction, lodging, sanitation, vehicle routes, environmental protection, and commercial activities during the pilgrimage period. The content focuses on regulatory compliance and legal frameworks rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
